tasks.label: Build & Install qameleon
args: cd libs/qameleon && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && make -j$(nproc) && sudo make install
tasks.detail: Build and install qameleon library to /usr/local

tasks.label: Build QameleonGUI
args: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && make -j$(nproc)

tasks.label: Run QameleonGUI
tasks.detail: Run QameleonGUI application with proper QML import path

tasks.label: Clean qameleon
args: cd libs/qameleon && rm -rf build && sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/cmake/qameleon /usr/local/qml/org/qameleon
tasks.detail: Clean qameleon build directory and remove installed files

tasks.label: Rebuild All
tasks.detail: Clean and rebuild both qameleon and QameleonGUI

tasks.label: Debug Build qameleon
args: cd libs/qameleon && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && make -j$(nproc) && sudo make install
tasks.detail: Build qameleon in Debug mode with compile commands

tasks.label: Release Build qameleon
args: cd libs/qameleon && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j$(nproc) && sudo make install
